messages:
jordan_sales: Quick heads-up — VertexHealth POC is paused. CTO (Raj) wants exec signoff on estimated monthly run-rate. He's also flagged SSO + data residency as hard blockers. Need ops/legal/infra help. @micah_engineering @rafael_ops @lilith_legal
micah_engineering: On it. Can you paste the perf/throughput numbers and the model variant they're testing? We can propose a cheaper quantized fallback if latency allows.
jordan_sales: Test traffic: ~120 qps, avg p99 220ms on hosted; they're using redwood/gpt-medium-v1. They want <150ms p99 for 95% of calls. Cost estimate they saw: ~$12k/mo — Raj says too high.
rafael_ops: We can offer Dedicated burst plan + autoscale to cap egress. Also VPC peering option for data residency. Need to confirm region (eu-west-1?).
lilith_legal: I need a filled security questionnaire and an LOA for KMS if they're bringing keys. Share questionnaire link: https://redwood.example.com/sec-quest
anya_ciso: Crypto/KMS: confirm if customer wants BYO-KMS or Redwood-managed. If BYO, need attestation and key rotation window. Also ask them to specify data classification.
jordan_sales: Raj prefers BYO-KMS. I've attached his note in the doc: https://docs.internal/vertex-poc/notes (internal). I'll start the sec-quest and request LOA.
micah_engineering: For perf: if we switch to redwood/gpt-medium-quant we can hit ~160ms p99 on Dedicated with proper batching. Not sure about 150ms guarantee. Proposed rollout: canary on Dedicated + fallback to hosted lower-cost model.
jordan_sales: Can we put a temporary rate cap so cost doesn't blow up while we iterate? Raj wants a hard spending cap.
rafael_ops: Yes — we can enforce per-customer rate limits via token policy. I'll create a quota: max 200k tokens/day and alert at 80%.
deploy-bot: ticket created: POC-17482 — "VertexHealth POC: Exec signoff + KMS + Pricing". Assignees: rafael_ops, lilith_legal, micah_engineering.
lilith_legal: I'll review the LOA and draft contract amendment for BYO-KMS. ETA EOD tomorrow.
anya_ciso: Also run a quick threat model: external access vectors and logging retention. Need to confirm retention period (customer request?).
jordan_sales: Raj asked for 90-day logs retention.
micah_engineering: Action: I'll spin up a Dedicated canary with quant variant tonight, run 2h smoke with perf capture, send results here.
rafael_ops: I'll provision the VPC peering in eu-west-1 and pre-seed routing rules. ETA 6h.
lilith_legal: I'll flag the pricing ask to finance — we can offer a 3-month pilot discount if exec signs off now.
jordan_sales: Great. Summary: (1) Micah — canary + perf capture (tonight). (2) Rafael — VPC/KMS setup + quota (6h). (3) Lilith — LOA + contract amendment + pricing pilot (EOD/tom). (4) Anya — security attestation checklist. Raj expects decision by EOD tomorrow. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
anya_ciso: Acknowledged. I'll send checklist and required docs.
jordan_sales: Thanks all — will update Raj after micah's smoke. :pray:
